tickets.title: 기준선 확인
notes: Baseline tests and the audit reproduction were run on 2026-09-15. Plan schema verification passes with system jsonschema 4.26.0; runtime .venv receives the pinned dependency through requirements-dev CI setup.

tickets.title: 긴급 결함 수정
notes: F01–F08 scoped fixes and offline regression tests completed. Live LLM and email integrations were intentionally not run.

tickets.title: 계약·경로·저장
notes: Offline path, storage, CAS, orphan, projection, containment, lease, and domain-pack fallback tests completed.

tickets.title: 수집·캐시
notes: Offline exact-cache, collection outcome, canonical-ID, context, classifier, aggregate, and extraction tests completed. Legacy script wrapper migration remains compatible during v1 transition.

tickets.title: 프로세스·backend
notes: Offline subprocess, strict JSON, timeout/process-group cleanup, output limits, role resolution, help probes, failure classification, and redacted diagnostics verified. Live authenticated probes remain unrun.

tickets.title: 작업 계획·합성
notes: Planner, result envelope, optional enrichment warning, budget/deadline guard, immutable attempt ledger, resume/invalidation, and repair helpers are verified offline. Legacy market/self wrappers now route planning and result ingestion through services/engine.py, and Engine.resume() recovers a pending run after restart.

tickets.title: 검증·마켓 렌더
notes: Offline schema/ref/category/coverage checks, hash freshness gate, safe renderer, and HELD watermark are covered.
The legacy newsletter post wrapper now routes its gate through validation.validate_briefing, deliverable_is_current, and render.HELD_WATERMARK instead of duplicating gate logic.

tickets.title: 자사 PR 분해
notes: Pure PR pipeline and export/render helpers are offline-covered, and the legacy self-brief wrapper now derives PR counts/tones from services/self_workflow (F14 newline CSV count fixed).

tickets.title: 발송·맥락 원장
notes: Local transport, reservation/dedupe, one-way receipt states, unknown-on-transport-exception, and candidate promotion gate are offline-covered; provider modules and operational resolver remain.

tickets.title: 설치·설정
notes: Offline runtime fingerprint/ready marker, structured doctor checks, and config migration are implemented. upgrade_config() fills newly added template keys into an existing config/runtime.yaml (user values and lists preserved, one-time .bak backup, idempotent) and init wires it into the seeding path; covered offline in tests/test_setup_migration_v1.py. Only actual pip-based dependency installation/rollback remains environment-sensitive and out of offline scope.

tickets.title: CLI·스케줄
notes: Canonical run creation, persisted planning, JSON next-actions, schedule conflict handling, and scoped ingest rejection are implemented offline. Lifecycle is now complete: status/resume/cancel/runs delegate to RunStore and Engine.resume, and the legacy positional date/hours ambiguity is rejected in favour of the canonical YYYY-MM-DD form.

tickets.title: 호스트 패키징
notes: Allowlisted host staging, per-host manifest generation, and installed-host manifest parsing/loading (load_installed_host) are offline-tested. Hermes native registration and live-host install dry-run require a running host and remain T14 scope.

tickets.title: 샘플·Pages
notes: Committed sample pages and source anchors have an offline verifier; deterministic rebuild was run twice locally. Responsive viewport meta and structural accessibility (html lang, single h1, no skipped heading levels, img alt text, accessible link names) are now checked offline via stdlib html.parser with no browser or network. Live GitHub Pages deployment verification requires a deployed site and stays in T14 (live) scope.

tickets.title: CI·문서
notes: Offline CI runs a ubuntu-latest/macos-latest x 3.11/3.12 matrix with the 'not live' marker only; local evidence is 245 passed. The runbook was audited against the completed T05-T12 state: HELD recovery now names the real lifecycle commands (jobs/repair/resume/status/runs/cancel/revise), config recovery distinguishes migrate_config (legacy import) from upgrade_config (template key fill), and the release checklist points at the actual sample verifier invocation. Windows runners, live host install, and live release gates remain T14 scope.

tickets.title: 실제 통합·출시
notes: Offline/package/probe evidence is recorded. Authenticated host, Hermes headless, network collection, and live release gates remain intentionally unrun.

known_environment_issues: Hermes launcher references missing venv Python; do not treat shutil.which success as readiness.
